InfraBot: :rotating_light: Incident opened — smart-routing detected oscillating health-check failures causing cross-region fallback loop (us-east <-> us-west <-> eu). Affected service: /api/v1/generate. Symptom: repeated 503s and p95 latency > 3s across multiple customers. Probe events increasing in last 3m.
Samira: I'm oncall. Acknowledging. Triage: is this a policy change or infra flake?
Miguel: I pushed a routing policy tweak ~10m ago (PR #3421) that widened fallback eligibility to include a lower-tier variant in eu. Reverting now if it's related.
Arya: Observing backend logs — health-check pings show alternating success/fail across regions every ~30s. Looks like probes are triggering fallback and then clearing, then triggering again.
Eva: Support: several enterprise customers reported 503s and request timeouts. Ticket queue rising, CS notified customers with a blameless note.
Samira: Can we pause automated fallback to stop the oscillation? If we disable fallback, traffic should stick to origin region and reduce thrash.
Miguel: I can toggle the smart-routing policy. Command I'll run:
```
# disable cross-region automatic fallback
redwoodctl routing update --policy smart_fallback --auto-fallback=false --reason "incident 2929998888"
```
Miguel: Running that now... DeployBot: routing-config v1.94 -> v1.95 applied (id: cfg-8392).
DeployBot: Change completed in 18s across control-plane nodes.
Samira: Monitor latency and error rate after change. Arya, can you check the probe frequency and any downstream retries?
Arya: Probe rate unchanged but fail-count dropped immediately after policy toggle. Error rate on /api/v1/generate p95 latency down from 3.2s -> 0.9s over 2m. No new 503s in the last minute.
Miguel: Reverted PR #3421 in case the variant matching rules caused premature fallback. I'll post the revert PR link: https://repo/redwood/PR/3433
Eva: CS update: sending customers an "incident in progress" update, advising degraded behavior may have occurred ~10:20–10:38 UTC. ETA for final status TBD.
Samira: Paging note: PagerDuty triggered twice. PagerDuty: the on-call rotation escalated to Samira then to Miguel per policy.
PagerDuty: Acknowledged by Samira at 2929998890.
Arya: Root cause hypothesis: a combination of widened variant eligibility + transient packet loss on one eu health-check path caused intermittent probe failures. Smart-routing saw region as unhealthy, triggered fallback to next region, then health check returned healthy -> backfill -> loop.
Miguel: Mitigation steps done: 1) auto-fallback disabled, 2) revert PR, 3) increased probe debounce window on eu from 5s -> 20s to avoid flip-flop. Command:
```
redwoodctl probes update --region eu --debounce 20s --reason "prevent flip-flop"
```
DeployBot: Probe config updated.
Samira: Impact summary for post-incident report: window 2929998860–2929998900 (approx). Affected endpoints: /api/v1/generate. Symptoms: high p95 latency, intermittent 503s. Estimated customer impact: 8% of requests to that endpoint returned 503s for impacted customers; three enterprise tenants reported visible errors.
Eva: Logged affected customers: acme-inc, beta-platform, and gamma-sys. CS outreach in progress.
Arya: I'm collecting traces and will attach histograms to the incident page. Initial telemetry link: https://telemetry/redwood/incident/2929998888
Samira: Can we re-enable auto-fallback in a controlled way? Proposal: re-enable with stricter variant matching and longer debounce, then canary for 5% traffic for 30 minutes.
Miguel: Agree. I'll open a canary rollout plan after revert is in prod and probes are stable.
Samira: Great. For now mark incident as mitigated — traffic stable and error rate back to baseline. I'll leave this in "monitoring" and tag for postmortem.
Samira: Incident status: MITIGATED :white_check_mark: at 2929998999. Next steps: Miguel to produce change blameless postmortem and PR checklist updates; Arya to attach telemetry; Eva/CS to finalize customer comms. Assignments: Miguel, Arya, Eva.
Miguel: Copy. I'll draft the postmortem and proposed policy guardrails (variant gating + perf tests).
Arya: Adding follow-ups: add probe hysteresis to default routing configs, add synthetic tests for multi-region probe oscillation.
Eva: I'll close customer tickets after final note.
Samira: Thanks team. Closing the page when postmortem is ready. :thumbsup:
